purpose: Validate rough first-order gains at relevant operating states; preserve nonlinear and context-dependent relationships.

priorities.task: Validate selected important control-response conditions with longer windows.
priorities.rationale: Current 500 ms scoring window generates only 20 MEC tasks per case.
priorities.protocol: Define a new scoring/follow-up window before launch; do not silently pool different horizons.

priorities.task: Add traffic-state coverage, including an appropriate URLLC-pressure scenario.
priorities.protocol: Keep the native scene separately; label pressure conditions and estimate gains per traffic state.

planned_protocol.radio_and_ue_resources: Keep six UEs and identical radio resources between matched native/burst cases.
planned_protocol.traffic: Use the existing equal-mean burst preset; keep scenario load identical in the native comparator.
planned_protocol.controllers: All xApps off while measuring controlled parameter perturbations.
planned_protocol.acceptance: Observe nonconstant, nonsaturated URLLC failure responses before identifying gains; retain zero or uncertain outcomes honestly.
planned_protocol.storage: Keep native and pressure measurements and gain matrices separate with explicit scenario context.
planned_protocol.execution_status: Planned; no new simulation launched in this UI correction.

priorities.task: Increase independent seeds for material but uncertain responses.
priorities.protocol: Target selected relations rather than repeating the entire matrix.

reuse_without_new_simulation: Estimate local or piecewise first-order gains from the retained grid near the operating point.
interpretation_rules: Low linear R-squared alone does not establish no influence.
A small average slope must be checked against measured nonlinear excursions.
All-zero failures or saturated success represent the observed regime, not global independence.
Weak effects may be de-emphasized; large uncertain or nonlinear effects remain candidates.
Group-control gains do not identify arbitrary individual-user action magnitudes.
retention: Preserve all completed data, checkpoints, caches and trained model files.
execution: No new simulation is launched by retaining this proposal.
